_readme: Tyms MI — official MCP Registry server.json drafts (refreshed 2026-11-09 from the
control-plane generated set; closes C8b: adds the coffee-prices-ug draft and
remotes[].supportedProtocolVersions on every draft).
The registry publishes ONE server per server.json; it has no multi-server publish.
Extract any element of `drafts` into its own server.json and run:
mcp-publisher validate server.json && mcp-publisher publish
Namespace ai.tyms/* is DNS-authenticated at the tyms.ai apex (TXT in place;
Ed25519 key staged at ~/.config/tyms/mcp-registry-ed25519.key on the devbox).
Hostname: drafts point at production mi-api.tyms.ai (verified live 2026-11-08:
all 13 /mcp/{domain}/{region} routes answer 401 + RFC 9728 resource_metadata).
2026-11-10: canonical mounts moved to /mcp/mi/{domain}/{region} and the unified
surface /mcp/mi shipped (tyms-mi-api PR #12); legacy /mcp/{domain}/{region}
paths 308-redirect. Draft URLs updated to the canonical mounts; an
ai.tyms/market-intelligence draft for the unified surface was added and is the
recommended listing. Publication remains on HOLD pending owner approval.
Descriptions are capped at 100 chars by the registry; all drafts comply (see _descriptionLengths).
supportedProtocolVersions matches what production serves: the 2026-11-08 deploy
(version c33e0a70, master f996a25 incl. v2 SDK 0acb012) ships 2025-03-26, 2025-06-18 and
2025-11-25 — verified live on all 12 routes 2026-11-08 (initialize + tools/list 163
tools titled; production pre-flight green). 2026-11-09 offline real-route contract snapshot: 168 tools titled; no deploy performed. Control-plane platform config, the three
rendered surfaces and this copy changed in one step (mcp-general-principles §9).
websiteUrl carries venue=mcp-registry UTM attribution (playbook.md §0.3); registry
remotes[].url stays canonical (no query params).
